Button
@tess/button
v1.0.0
Verified

Tactile, accessible multi-intent button primitive with Quiet, Expressive, and Nocturne curated configurations.

Install:
tess add button
npx shadcn@latest add https://tessellate.design/r/button.json

SUMMARY & PURPOSE

Primary and secondary interactive action trigger for initiating operations, submitting forms, or navigating.

WHEN IT WORKS (IDEAL FOR)
•
Primary forms
•
Dialog actions
•
Toolbar triggers
•
Card actions
WHEN IT IS INAPPROPRIATE (AVOID FOR)
•
In-line body copy links
•
Dense table cell status indicators
JOBS TO BE DONE
Submit user intent
Trigger modal dialog
Confirm dangerous operation
Cancel ongoing action
EXPECTED CONTENT REQUIREMENTS
Brief imperative verb phrase

developer-tool (90%)
